The following is a [continuous renal replacement simulator](teaching/cvvh-simulator.html). I developed this with Claude
as an educational tool. Take it with a pinch of salt. While this LLMs are
reaching some incredible milestone, they do still often make mistakes.
Since this is a combindation of code, maths and physics, it should be something
it is very good at. I have not found any mistakes so far! But do let me know
if you see something odd.
